Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Nurse - II. This is a contractual position offered by AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Nurse - II post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Project Nurse - II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Three-year General Nursing & Midwife (GNM) Course to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20000 per month, plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held on 03 September 2026. Candidates should report on time.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Nurse - II post?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Screening Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in venue details are usually provided in the official notification. Candidates are advised to refer to the notification for the exact address and reporting time.
